def _tuple_to_dict(t):
    """Convert a tuple of up to 5 elements to a dict for comparison.
    Missing elements are treated as zeros for major/minor/patch and None for prerelease/build.
    """
    major = t[0] if len(t) > 0 else 0
    minor = t[1] if len(t) > 1 else 0
    patch = t[2] if len(t) > 2 else 0
    prerelease = t[3] if len(t) > 3 else None
    build = t[4] if len(t) > 4 else None
    return {'major': major, 'minor': minor, 'patch': patch, 'prerelease': prerelease, 'build': build}
